BiblicalUsage: Gad is coriander seed, the small round seed the manna resembled. The house of Israel called the bread manna, and it was like coriander seed, white, in Exodus 16:31, and the manna was as coriander seed in colour as bdellium in Numbers 11:7. The word gives us the size and shape of the daily bread God sent.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the manna's likeness to coriander seed shows how ordinary God's provision looks; it was small and round and came every morning, and I hold that God still feeds His people with daily bread that looks like nothing much.
